Coram : PINAKI CHANDRA GHOSE*, R.F. NARIMAN
Terrorist and Disruptive Activities (Prevention) Act, 1987 - s.20A - Cognizance of offence - Prior approval of sanctioning authority - Compliance of - On facts, individual attacked by appellants with weapons, resulting in his death - Conviction of the appellants uls. J 20B rlw and 149 JPC and ss. 3(2), (3), (4) of TADA and sentenced to life imprisonment by courts below - On appeal, held: Section 20-A(l) must be construed by indicating that prior approval from the competent authority is mandatory for taking cognizance of offence punishable under TADA - However,
